follow_ups.note: Incorporate timer-advancement mechanism into simulation_run mode-2 (автопрогон). Pattern: GET /management/timer-jobs?processInstanceId={id} to find job by elementId → POST {action:move} → poll tasks until expected state. Account for async executor lag ~5-10s (observed up to ~12s under Docker/Compose).

Latency note: async executor lag is ~5-10s (configurable via flowable.async-executor-activate and polling interval). In simulation_run mode-2 sequential timer chains, factor this as per-step wait. Not blocking for day-1 non-real-time autorun.
